Command.Comment: Explicitly authorized frozen Phase 8 main campaign start, serial originals only

commands:
set -eu
cd /opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/.venv-analysis/lib/python3.12/site-packages:$PWD/.venv-transport/lib/python3.12/site-packages
.venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'artifacts/phase-8-review-freeze/v2'))
from runner import verify_host_timer,verify_run,meter,cloud_for
from controls import guard,Journal,utc,read
root=Path('/var/lib/p8/run');auth=verify_run(root);verify_host_timer(root)
if read(Path('/var/lib/p8-deployment/final-readiness.json'))['status']!='PASS':raise ValueError('READINESS_NOT_PASS')
if (root/'pause.json').exists():raise ValueError('PAUSED_ADMISSIONS')
if any(r['state']!='PLANNED' for r in Journal(root).rows()):raise ValueError('ALREADY_ADMITTED_DO_NOT_START_AGAIN')
cloud=cloud_for(root);guard(auth.policy,meter(root),utc(),cloud.inventory(),extra_bytes=auth.policy.slot_capacity_reserve_bytes)
print('PASS final admission gate')
PY
systemctl start fyp-phase8-campaign.service
systemctl is-active fyp-phase8-campaign.service fyp-phase8-watchdog.service fyp-phase8-hardstop.timer
systemctl show fyp-phase8-campaign.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p Restart
journalctl -u fyp-phase8-campaign.service -n 8 --no-pager
